question: Which of the following polyhalogen compounds is used in the production of the freon refrigerant R-22?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chloroform**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chloroform** is used in the production of the freon refrigerant R-22.
 
• R-22, also known as HCFC-22, is a hydrochlorofluorocarbon that has been widely used as a refrigerant in air conditioning and refrigeration systems.
 
• The production of R-22 involves the reaction of chloroform with hydrogen fluoride.
 
• R-22 has been phased out in many countries due to its ozone-depleting potential, but it was historically significant in the refrigeration industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chloroform** (CHCl₃) is a colorless, sweet-smelling organic compound that is used as a solvent and in the production of various chemicals.
 
• It was once used as an anesthetic but has been replaced by safer alternatives due to its toxicity and potential for causing liver and kidney damage.
 
• The use of chloroform in industrial applications requires careful handling and adherence to safety protocols to prevent exposure and environmental contamination.
 
• Chloroform is classified as a possible human carcinogen by the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC).
 
• Freon R-22 has been replaced by more environmentally friendly refrigerants such as R-410A and R-32 in many applications.
